turns.learner: Hello! I need English for daily life here. Can we practise irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
Good choice, these verbs are very common. Quick question first: what is the past of "go", and does it end in -ed?

Here is a worked example (my own example):
I want to say: "Yesterday I / see / my cousin."
Step 1: "Yesterday" shows a finished action.
Step 2: "see" is irregular, so I do not add -ed. The past form is "saw".
Result: "Yesterday I saw my cousin."

Now you try a partly solved one. Step 1 is done: "Last week" shows the past, and "buy" is irregular, so no -ed.
"Last week she ___ (buy) a new bag."
Write only the verb.
